title: All Elementary Functions from a Single Operator
paper_sources: All elementary functions from a single operator.pdf
All elementary functions from a single operator.txt
working_hypothesis: AEFSO is more likely to be a representation-layer or symbolic-search primitive than a direct replacement for TOE core physics models.

what_it_proved: Single-operator representation sufficiency is a real mathematical claim worth bounded testing.
AEFSO remains viable as a backend normalization and symbolic-search surface.
The experiment exposed the missing intermediate-representation layer TOE actually needs.
promotion_blockers: Does not preserve native readability on governance-facing or geometry-facing contracts.
Handles multiplication-heavy and sign-sensitive helper math too opaquely.
Does not improve reviewability of threshold, guard, or branch-carrying expressions.
missing_link_properties: Review-surface preservation for beta, omega, and EFT inequalities
next_actions: test hybrid IR rather than full AEFSO replacement
carry positivity and branch metadata explicitly
retest only if bounded complexity and reviewability improve
screen_summary.why_it_matters: AEFSO did not become TOE core math, but it produced a more valuable output than a binary fail: a concrete specification for the missing IR between search-uniform syntax and governance-readable equations.
